purpose.domain_detail: Warehouse/inventory management system - prints margin analysis (marginalità) for individual product movements per customer, likely for a wholesale/distribution company in Italy
purpose.summary: This program generates a CSV report of product margin analysis for individual warehouse movements per customer (Stampa Marginalità prodotti singoli movimenti Clienti). It reads movement headers and lines, looks up articles, customers, price lists, taxes, and supplier costs, then outputs a CSV file for Excel. It handles GDO (large-scale retail) customer type differentiation and price/margin calculations.

notable_features: Extensive COPY statements (56 copybooks) for file control and FD entries
DECLARATIVES with USE AFTER ERROR for multiple files
DISPLAY MESSAGE with TITLE/ICON (ACUCOBOL GUI extensions)
88-level condition with WHEN SET TO FALSE clause
CALL to 'geslock' with CANCEL (lock management subprogram)
LUBEXX prefix on some lines suggesting code tagging/modification markers

The program is clearly part of a larger Italian business application suite (warehouse/ERP) built with ACUCOBOL-GT.
